# Preference optimisation toward clean oud qaraami (Stage 5)

*Generated by `apps/ai-service/scripts/dpo_report.py` from the run artifacts; rerun after every stage.*

## Why

The supervised adapters learn the corpus as recorded, tape hiss included. In the blind test on the large adapter the adapter was preferred, and called noisy. Stage 5 keeps the adapters and changes what they are optimised for: closeness to the real oud recordings, less hiss, more trackable pentatonic melody. No new recordings are used.

## Method

Direct preference optimisation on the LoRA adapter (`scripts/dpo_train.py`). Per round: K samples for each of P prompts from the oud caption grammar (lead instrument × tempo × pentatonic tonic), re-encoded with the model's own EnCodec; the composite reward (`scripts/reward_model.py`) ranks them; best-vs-worst pairs above a margin; the reference policy is the adapter at the start of the round, its log-probabilities cached; DPO loss on length-normalised token log-probabilities with every module dropout zeroed so policy and reference are the same function of the weights (at step 1 the loss is ln 2 and the margin 0, as it must be). Evaluation on 40 held-out prompts: reward terms, MERT-FAD to the 276 real oud test clips, held-out oud token cross-entropy as a collapse guard, and an A/B set for the blind listening test.

### Reward

* **oud_dist**: Mahalanobis distance in a 32-d PCA space of MERT-v1-95M embeddings fitted on the 1,512 real oud training clips (the PCA keeps 96.4% of the variance); FAD noise floor between the real test split halves 0.265.
* **band_snr_db**: median minus 10th-percentile energy of the 3–10 kHz band across frames; stationary hiss fills that band in quiet moments. Real cassette 4.5 dB, real oud 8.3, base MusicGen 10.4. On the 7 blind pairs annotated "noisy", the noisy clip reads 4.3 dB against 11.6 for the other.
* **melody**: PCS × min(voiced fraction, 0.6)/0.6, from the project's pitch scorer; a penalty for clips with < 15% voiced frames.
* composite R = z(−oud_dist) + 0.5 z(−hiss) + 0.5 z(melody) − 2·[near-silent], z-scored within the scored pool.

The listener's choices track the melody term and go against the hiss term (he chose the hissy clip every time); the reward is tuned to the stated goal, clean oud qaraami, not to those choices.

### small, oud adapter

`facebook/musicgen-small` from `oud_lora_r16_nodrop_20260809/ckpt_step_0500`; 96 prompts × 4 samples of 15 s → 96 pairs (margin 0.5 z); DPO β 5.0 on mean token log-probs, lr 5e-05, 3 epochs, 144 steps. Sampling 31.0 min, training 35.5 min, eval 78.4 min.

| measure | before | after | note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| reward | -0.675 | 0.675 | composite, z-scored over the union of both sides |
| oud_dist | 5.692 | 4.286 | Mahalanobis distance to the real oud clips (real train 4.20, test 4.13) |
| oud_sim | 0.872 | 0.921 | cosine to the real-oud centroid |
| band_snr_db | 13.089 | 15.868 | 3–10 kHz band SNR (real cassette 4.5, real oud 8.3) |

| voiced_fraction | 0.621 | 0.510 | trackable melody |
| noise_floor_db | -24.554 | -25.477 | 10th-percentile frame RMS |
| MERT-FAD to real oud test | 0.511 | 0.498 | 40 eval prompts per side; indicative only at this n in 32-d |
| held-out oud token CE | 4.4071 | 4.6863 | 64 unseen-song clips; the collapse guard |

Training curve: final DPO loss 0.0219, implicit-reward margin 3.8428 (β × per-token log-ratio difference), pair accuracy over the last ten steps 0.90; chosen log-ratio -0.475, rejected -1.244 nats per token.

Blind test set: `data/ab_dpo_small_oud/` (pairNNN_base = before, pairNNN_adapter = after, same prompt and seed).

## Reading the numbers

A fall in oud_dist toward the real clips' 4.1–4.2 with band SNR rising toward or past the real oud clips' 8.3 dB is the intended effect. A rise in held-out token CE means the policy is a worse density model of the corpus than the adapter it started from; DPO trades likelihood for preference and the size of that trade is reported, not hidden. The reward can be won without winning a listener: the before/after blind test on each `data/ab_dpo_<tag>/` set is the arbiter.
